decisions.decision: Store gross XRPL issuer obligations, operational/hot-wallet balances, externally circulating supply, Ethereum totalSupply and other-chain supply separately, each with pinned ledger/block and explicit wallet exclusions.
reject: Treat either provider value as universal supply
Infer burn, bridge or sale from the difference

decisions.decision: Keep raw payments and separate adjusted measures for dust, clusters, issuer mint/redeem, exchange loops, self-payments, round trips and unique counterparties.
decisions.reason: Bitquery reports 99.6% of 30-day RLUSD payment count concentrated in a 110-wallet dust cluster.

decisions.decision: Do not admit x402 transaction count, merchant count or active-agent count until SourceTag 804681468 is joined to raw payment hashes and t54 event IDs.
decisions.reason: Three exact destination addresses overlap with Bitquery collectors.

decisions.decision: Do not infer XRP demand from stablecoin supply/count alone; require net external XRP acquisition, bridge inventory, collateral encumbrance, market-maker inventory and fee-burn evidence.
decisions.reason: Stablecoin transfers can settle without sustained net XRP purchases.

decisions.decision: Store issuer-level holdings, creations/redemptions, AUM, price effect, fund universe and timestamp separately; do not merge Maketo and XRP Insights until reconciled.
Treat attributed wallet totals as custody/omnibus inventory, not tradable float; preserve cold-storage and cbXRP overlap labels.
decisions.reason: Exchange totals include cold storage and exchange-controlled reserves.

decisions.decision: Normalize by venue, contract, quote currency, margin mode, timestamp and provider coverage; never average incompatible series.
decisions.reason: Seven-exchange OI and Binance USDT-perpetual OI are different universes.

decisions.decision: No forecast until point-in-time features, source hashes, leakage checks, baseline, walk-forward evaluation, calibration and shadow outcome capture exist.
decisions.reason: No verified out-of-sample XRP skill estimate is available.

prediction_policy: Every prediction records cutoff, target, horizon, assumptions, probability, confidence, alternatives, source hashes and later outcome. No guarantee claims.
